news.titleEn: July Jobs Report Reveals Unexpected Loss of 23,000 Jobs, Missing Economists' Forecasts
news.conclusionEn: The US economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, far below forecasts of roughly 95,000 in gains, while May and June figures were revised down a combined 103,000 and unemployment fell to 4.1% as workers left the labor force.
news.conclusionZh: 美国7月意外裁减2.3万个岗位，远逊预期新增9.5万，前两月数据下修10.3万，失业率降至4.1%。
news.whyEn: As the week's biggest US economic release, the shock jobs loss reshapes expectations for Fed policy and has already driven a stock rally, a weaker dollar and higher gold prices.
news.whyZh: 作为本周最重磅美国经济数据，就业意外下滑重塑了市场对美联储政策的预期，已推动股市上涨、美元走弱及金价走高。
news.detailEn: The Labor Department said nonfarm payrolls fell by 23,000 in July, well below the roughly 95,000 gain economists polled by FactSet had expected, with local government education losing 50,000 jobs and retail down 19,000. May and June payrolls were also revised down by a combined 103,000, meaning many previously reported job gains never really existed. The unemployment rate ticked down to 4.1% from 4.2%, but only because labor force participation fell to 61.4%, its lowest since February 2021, as workers stopped looking for jobs rather than found them. Wage growth also cooled, with average hourly earnings up just 3.2% over 12 months, the slowest pace since May 2021, reinforcing bets that the Federal Reserve will hold off on raising rates and may lean toward cuts later this year.
news.detailZh: 美国劳工部数据显示，7月非农就业岗位减少2.3万个，远低于FactSet调查的经济学家预期新增约9.5万个；其中地方政府教育部门减少5万个岗位，零售业减少1.9万个。5月及6月数据合计下修10.3万，意味着此前公布的多项就业增长其实并不存在。失业率从4.2%降至4.1%，但原因是劳动力参与率降至61.4%（2021年2月以来最低），即更多人退出求职而非找到工作。薪资增长也在放缓，过去12个月平均时薪仅增长3.2%，为2021年5月以来最慢增速，进一步强化市场对美联储今年稍晚放缓加息甚至转向降息的预期。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 Rises to Record Close Friday and Posts Strongest Week Since April
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 closed at a record 7,757.64 on Friday and the Nasdaq jumped 1.3%, as investors read the shock July jobs loss as reducing pressure on the Fed to keep rates elevated.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500周五收于7757.64点历史新高，纳指涨1.3%，市场将就业数据疲软解读为美联储降息信号。
news.whyEn: A record-setting rally driven by a weak jobs report shows markets are now pricing in a more dovish Fed path, a shift that affects borrowing costs, stock valuations and the dollar worldwide.
news.whyZh: 疲软就业数据推动股市创新高，显示市场正押注美联储转向更宽松立场，将影响全球借贷成本、股票估值及美元走势。
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 advanced 0.62% to a record close of 7,757.64, the Nasdaq Composite climbed 1.3% to 26,690.62, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 151.83 points to 54,036.93. For the week, the S&P 500 gained roughly 3.6%, its best weekly performance since April, as traders concluded the surprise 23,000 job loss in July meant the Federal Reserve would not need to raise rates and could hold policy steady or eventually cut. The rally extended a run in which the S&P first closed above 7,700 earlier in the week, with gains led by rate-sensitive technology and growth stocks.
news.detailZh: 标普500指数上涨0.62%，收于历史新高7757.64点；纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.3%，收于26690.62点；道琼斯工业平均指数上涨151.83点，收于54036.93点。本周标普500累计上涨约3.6%，为4月以来表现最佳的一周，交易员认为7月意外减少2.3万个就业岗位意味着美联储无需加息，甚至可能转向降息。此轮上涨延续了本周早些时候标普500首次收于7700点上方的势头，涨幅主要由对利率敏感的科技与成长股带动。

news.titleEn: Saudi Arabia Turns to Muslim Military Heavyweights in Landmark Defense Pact as Iran War Closes In
news.conclusionEn: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and nuclear-armed Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement, a mutual-defense pact declaring an attack on any one of the three an attack on all, as Saudi Arabia faces escalating strikes tied to the Iran war.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特、土耳其与拥核国家巴基斯坦签署「麦加联合威慑协议」，规定三国中任一方遭袭视为对三方共同攻击。
news.whyEn: A formal mutual-defense pact involving a nuclear power reshapes Middle East security alignments and raises the stakes of the ongoing Iran conflict for regional and global markets, especially oil and shipping.
news.whyZh: 涉及核大国的正式互防协议重塑中东安全格局，使持续的伊朗冲突对区域及全球市场（尤其石油与航运）的影响升级。
news.detailEn: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif signed the pact in Mecca on Friday after nearly a year of negotiations, agreeing that an armed attack on any of the three nations will be treated as an attack on all and pledging deeper defense cooperation. The agreement comes as Saudi Arabia has been repeatedly struck since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February, both directly and by Iran-aligned Houthi forces in Yemen, including a strike that wounded 11 civilians in Najran province. By formalizing ties with Pakistan, a nuclear-armed state, the pact is widely seen as extending an informal deterrent umbrella over Saudi Arabia at a moment when the wider Iran conflict continues to threaten regional shipping and oil infrastructure.
news.detailZh: 土耳其总统埃尔多安、沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼与巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫历经近一年谈判，于周五在麦加签署该协议，约定三国中任一方遭受武装攻击将被视为对三方的共同攻击，并承诺深化防务合作。该协议签署之际，自今年2月美国和以色列对伊朗发动打击以来，沙特已多次遭到直接攻击及也门胡塞武装的袭击，其中一次打击造成纳季兰省11名平民受伤。由于巴基斯坦是拥核国家，该协议被广泛视为在伊朗冲突持续威胁地区航运与石油设施之际，为沙特提供了某种非正式的核威慑保护伞。

news.titleEn: De la Espriella Sworn in as Colombia's Leader, Vows Armed Group Crackdown
news.conclusionEn: Hard-right lawyer Abelardo de la Espriella was inaugurated as Colombia's president in Cali, pledging a militarized crackdown on armed groups and up to 40% cuts to government spending, backed by a pledged $1 billion in US security assistance.
news.conclusionZh: 右翼律师德拉埃斯普列拉在卡利宣誓就任哥伦比亚总统，誓言强硬打击武装团体并削减最多40%政府开支。
news.whyEn: Colombia's swing to a hard-right, US-aligned government marks a major political reversal in Latin America's third-largest economy, with implications for regional security policy, drug-trafficking crackdowns and US relations.
news.whyZh: 哥伦比亚转向强硬右翼、亲美政府，是拉美第三大经济体的重大政治转向，将影响地区安全政策、缉毒行动及美哥关系。
news.detailEn: De la Espriella, 48, took the oath of office on Friday in Cali rather than the traditional capital Bogota, symbolizing his administration's focus on the volatile southwest where armed groups remain active. He declared that 'the option of dialogue is completely exhausted' with armed groups, signaling a shift from predecessor Gustavo Petro's approach, and outlined plans to cut government spending by up to 40%, revive the oil and gas sector including fracking, and pursue austerity to restore investor confidence. The US State Department said the Trump administration plans to provide $1 billion in security assistance pending congressional approval. His win extends a rightward shift across Latin America, with protests also breaking out in several cities from opponents questioning the legitimacy of his narrow runoff victory.
news.detailZh: 现年48岁的德拉埃斯普列拉周五在卡利而非传统首都波哥大宣誓就职，象征其政府将重点放在武装团体仍然活跃的西南部动荡地区。他宣称与武装团体「对话选项已彻底穷尽」，标志着与前任佩特罗路线的转变，并提出削减政府开支最多40%、复兴油气行业（含页岩油气开采）及推行紧缩政策以重振投资者信心等计划。美国国务院表示，特朗普政府计划提供10亿美元安全援助，尚待国会批准。他的胜选延续了拉美地区整体右转的趋势，但多个城市也爆发抗议，反对者质疑其在决选中微弱优势的合法性。

news.conclusionEn: Gold jumped 2.4% to $4,270.62 an ounce, up nearly 27% year-over-year, as the weak jobs report boosted expectations that the Federal Reserve will cut interest rates.
news.conclusionZh: 受疲软就业数据提振降息预期，金价单日上涨2.4%至每盎司4270.62美元，同比涨幅近27%。
news.whyEn: Gold's rapid climb toward record territory reflects investors hedging against inflation and rate-cut expectations, and is a closely watched signal of broader market risk sentiment.
news.whyZh: 金价快速逼近历史高位，反映投资者对冲通胀及押注降息，是市场整体风险情绪的重要风向标。
news.detailEn: Gold rose $99.63, or 2.38%, to $4,270.62 per ounce on August 6, extending a rally that has taken prices up more than 25% since early 2025 amid persistent inflation concerns and economic uncertainty. The move accelerated further after the July jobs report showed an unexpected loss of 23,000 jobs, which strengthened bets that the Federal Reserve will need to lower interest rates, denting the appeal of holding cash and boosting demand for the metal as a store of value. Analysts cited in the report continue to recommend gold as a portfolio diversifier during ongoing market turbulence.
news.detailZh: 8月6日金价上涨99.63美元，涨幅2.38%，报每盎司4270.62美元，延续自2025年初以来累计涨幅超25%的行情，通胀担忧与经济不确定性是主要推手。7月就业报告显示美国意外减少2.3万个岗位后，金价涨势进一步加快，市场对美联储降息的押注增强，削弱了持有现金的吸引力，提升了黄金作为保值资产的需求。报道中分析师仍建议在当前市场波动加剧的背景下，将黄金作为投资组合的分散配置工具。

news.titleEn: AMD Acquires AI Chip Startup Taalas to Boost Inference Performance by Etching Models into Silicon
news.conclusionEn: AMD agreed to acquire Toronto-based AI chip startup Taalas, which etches AI model weights directly into silicon instead of using HBM memory, to boost the speed and efficiency of its data-center AI inference offerings.
news.conclusionZh: AMD宣布收购多伦多AI芯片初创公司Taalas，该公司将AI模型权重直接蚀刻进芯片以提升推理速度与能效。
news.whyEn: The deal is AMD's second Canadian AI chip acquisition in about a year and signals intensifying competition with Nvidia over specialized inference hardware as AI compute demand keeps surging.
news.whyZh: 这是AMD一年内第二笔加拿大AI芯片收购，显示随着AI算力需求持续激增，AMD与英伟达在专用推理硬件领域的竞争正在加剧。
news.detailEn: Taalas, founded in 2023 and backed by $219 million in venture funding, builds model-specific integrated circuits that etch AI model weights directly into silicon rather than storing them in HBM memory, dramatically cutting compute and memory bottlenecks for inference. Its first test chip, built on TSMC's 6nm process, reportedly served Meta's Llama 3.1 8B model at nearly 17,000 tokens per second, though the approach trades away flexibility since a chip is locked to one model once deployed. AMD plans to integrate Taalas's technology with its Helios rack-scale systems, potentially pairing GPUs for prompt processing with Taalas accelerators for token generation. Financial terms were not disclosed, and the deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter pending regulatory approval.
news.detailZh: Taalas成立于2023年，已获得2.19亿美元风险投资，其专有技术是将AI模型权重直接蚀刻进「模型专用集成电路」，而非存储于HBM显存中，从而大幅降低推理过程中的算力与内存瓶颈。其基于台积电6纳米工艺打造的首款测试芯片，在运行Meta的Llama 3.1 8B模型时据称达到每秒近1.7万个token的处理速度，但这种方案牺牲了灵活性——芯片一旦部署便只能绑定单一模型。AMD计划将Taalas技术整合进其Helios机架级系统，可能采用GPU处理提示词、Taalas加速芯片负责token生成的组合方案。交易财务条款未披露，预计将于第四季度完成，尚待监管批准。

news.titleEn: OpenAI Says Apple's Own Security Practices Undermine Its Trade Secrets Case
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI filed a motion to dismiss Apple's trade secrets lawsuit, arguing Apple's own lax security practices — including employees using personal iCloud for work — undermine its claims, with a hearing set for October 1.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI提交动议要求驳回苹果的商业机密诉讼，称苹果自身安全管理松懈削弱其指控，听证会定于10月1日。
news.whyEn: The lawsuit and its outcome could shape how AI and hardware companies handle trade-secret disputes over former employees and product development, with a hearing that both companies' AI hardware plans are watching closely.
news.whyZh: 该诉讼结果或将影响AI与硬件企业在离职员工及产品研发相关商业机密纠纷中的处理方式，双方AI硬件计划都密切关注此案进展。
news.detailEn: In a 31-page motion filed August 5, OpenAI asked a federal judge to dismiss Apple's trade secrets lawsuit, arguing Apple failed to adequately identify the specific information it claims was stolen, instead citing only 'generic categories' of its product-development process. OpenAI also argued that Apple's own security lapses — including letting employees use personal iCloud accounts for work and failing to revoke a former engineer's access after he left the company — undermine any claim that the information was properly protected as a trade secret. OpenAI characterized the suit as a competitive tactic, saying Apple 'should not be permitted to use a baseless and pretextual lawsuit to make up for its shortcomings in the market for talent.' Apple must respond by August 19, with a key hearing scheduled for October 1 that could influence how the two companies collaborate on AI hardware and software going forward.
news.detailZh: OpenAI于8月5日提交一份31页的动议，要求联邦法官驳回苹果的商业机密诉讼，称苹果未能充分说明其所指控被窃取信息的具体内容，仅笼统提及产品研发过程中的「泛泛类别」。OpenAI还指出，苹果自身存在安全管理漏洞——包括允许员工使用个人iCloud账户处理工作，以及未能在一名工程师离职后及时撤销其访问权限——这些漏洞削弱了该信息作为受保护商业机密的主张。OpenAI将此诉讼定性为一种竞争手段，称苹果「不应被允许以毫无根据、别有用心的诉讼来掩盖自身在人才市场上的短板」。苹果须在8月19日前作出回应，关键听证会定于10月1日举行，其结果可能影响两家公司未来在AI硬件与软件方面的合作方式。

news.titleEn: White House to Host AI Companies to Review New Model-Testing Framework
news.conclusionEn: The White House invited Meta, OpenAI, Google and Anthropic to discuss a new voluntary framework for government safety testing of the most advanced US AI models, following recent disclosures that AI tools had breached other companies' systems.
news.conclusionZh: 白宫邀请Meta、OpenAI、谷歌与Anthropic商讨AI模型自愿安全测试新框架，此前有AI工具被曝曾入侵其他公司系统。
news.whyEn: The talks mark a step toward formalized US government oversight of frontier AI models and reflect growing concern in Washington that increasingly capable AI could be misused for cyberattacks.
news.whyZh: 此次会谈标志美国政府对前沿AI模型的监管迈向制度化，也反映华盛顿方面对日益强大的AI可能被用于网络攻击的担忧上升。
news.detailEn: Officials from Meta, OpenAI, Google and Anthropic met with White House representatives to discuss a voluntary framework stemming from a June executive order on AI cybersecurity, which calls for an opt-in approach to safety reviews rather than mandatory licensing. Under the proposed framework, companies could give the government early access to certain frontier models for up to 30 days for testing, but the process cannot be used to create a mandatory pre-clearance system. The meeting followed recent disclosures by Anthropic and OpenAI that their AI tools had been used to breach other companies' systems, stirring concern among lawmakers about AI-enabled cyberattacks and adding urgency to establishing a formal testing regime.
news.detailZh: Meta、OpenAI、谷歌及Anthropic的高层与白宫代表会面，讨论源于6月一项AI网络安全行政令的自愿测试框架，该行政令主张采取自愿申请式安全审查，而非强制许可制度。根据拟议框架，企业可自愿向政府提供最长30天的前沿模型早期测试权限，但该流程不得被用于构建强制性预先审批制度。此次会谈之前，Anthropic与OpenAI相继披露其AI工具曾被用于入侵其他公司系统，引发国会议员对AI可能助长网络攻击的担忧，也为建立正式测试机制增添了紧迫性。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what's already been spent, rather than evaluating the choice based on future costs and benefits. Sunk costs — money or time already spent — are gone regardless of what you decide next, so rational decisions should only weigh the marginal cost and benefit of continuing versus stopping. Falling for this fallacy causes managers and founders to keep funding failing projects, products or hires far longer than the evidence justifies.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误，是指人们因为已经投入了时间、金钱或精力，就倾向于继续投入，而不是基于未来的成本与收益来重新评估决策。已经花掉的钱或时间（沉没成本）无论接下来怎么选都无法收回，理性决策应只权衡「继续」与「停止」各自的边际成本与收益。陷入这一谬误会导致管理者和创业者，在证据早已表明该项目、产品或雇佣决策失败的情况下，仍长期持续投入。
businessTips.exampleEn: A startup has spent $200,000 building a feature that user testing shows customers don't want; instead of asking 'should we launch this?', the sunk cost fallacy pushes the team to keep polishing it because 'we've already come this far,' when the rational move is to redirect the remaining budget toward something customers actually value.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家创业公司已花费20万美元开发某项功能，但用户测试显示客户并不需要它；沉没成本谬误会让团队因为「都已经投入这么多了」而继续打磨，而不是重新评估「这个功能该不该上线」，理性的做法应是把剩余预算转向真正对客户有价值的方向。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the simplest version of a product that still lets you test the core idea with real users and gather feedback, before investing heavily in features nobody may want. The goal isn't to ship something low-quality, but to strip away everything except what's needed to validate the central assumption — does this solve a real problem people will pay for? Building an MVP first reduces wasted development time and lets founders learn and adjust based on real usage rather than guesses.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指在大规模投入开发可能没人需要的功能之前，先做出能让真实用户测试核心理念、收集反馈的最简版本产品。MVP的目标不是做出低质量的东西，而是去掉一切非必要功能，只保留验证核心假设所需的部分——这个产品能否解决人们愿意付费的真实问题？先做MVP能减少无谓的开发时间，让创始人根据真实使用情况而非猜测来学习和调整。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of spending six months building a full mobile app for a meal-planning side business, a founder first launches a simple weekly PDF meal plan sold through a landing page, and only builds the app once enough people pay for the PDF to prove there's real demand.
businessTips.exampleZh: 与其花六个月开发一款完整的膳食计划App，创始人先通过一个落地页销售一份简单的每周膳食计划PDF，只有在足够多的人愿意为PDF付费、证明确有真实需求后，才着手开发完整App。

businessTips.explanationEn: Asset allocation is how an investor divides money across different asset classes — such as stocks, bonds, cash and commodities like gold — based on their goals, time horizon and risk tolerance. Because different asset classes tend to perform differently under the same economic conditions, a well-diversified allocation smooths out overall portfolio swings compared with holding a single asset type. It's widely considered one of the biggest drivers of long-term investment returns, often mattering more than which individual stocks or funds are picked within each category.
businessTips.explanationZh: 资产配置是指投资者根据自身目标、投资期限与风险承受能力，将资金分配到不同资产类别——如股票、债券、现金及黄金等大宗商品之中。由于不同资产类别在相同经济环境下往往表现各异，合理分散的资产配置能比单一持仓更好地平滑整体投资组合的波动。资产配置被普遍认为是决定长期投资回报最重要的因素之一，其影响力通常超过在某类资产内部具体挑选哪只股票或基金。
businessTips.exampleEn: During this week's stock rally alongside a jump in gold prices, an investor holding a mix of 60% stocks, 30% bonds and 10% gold benefits from both the equity gains and gold's rise as a hedge, rather than being fully exposed to a single asset's swings.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周股市上涨的同时金价也同步走高，一位按60%股票、30%债券、10%黄金配置的投资者能同时受益于股票的涨幅与黄金的避险上涨，而不是把所有身家都押在单一资产的波动上。
